name: PCA CERVUS
description: Unified embedded-product platform for firmware-informed SBOM validation, component and vulnerability analysis, continuous monitoring and contextual threat intelligence.
use_case: Product security teams managing embedded devices, firmware and connected-product risks

profile.overview: PCA CERVUS combines embedded-device software composition analysis, SBOM validation, vulnerability monitoring and product-focused threat intelligence in one product. PCA Cyber Security uses automated firmware analysis to identify components, connect them to vulnerability intelligence and prioritize findings in the context of the actual product.
capabilities: SBOM creation and validation informed by firmware and software-component evidence
Automated software composition analysis and component-to-vulnerability mapping
Vulnerability prioritization for the monitored embedded product
Continuous monitoring of relevant security, technical and threat-intelligence sources
AI-assisted analysis, alerts and contextual product-security reporting
Analyst-supported investigation and exploitation validation in relevant service packages
profile.audience: Embedded-device manufacturers, product security and PSIRT teams, including automotive, industrial, IoT and other connected-product environments.
